Why is there a need for the Singapore Government Partnerships Office, and what does it do? 2. How does this website help me to partner the government for the public good? 3. How does the SGPO website differ from existing platforms like REACH? 1. Why is there a need for the Singapore Government Partnerships Office, and what does it do? Singapore faces complex challenges, and all of us can play a part in addressing them, and shaping our nation's future. As our society matures and becomes more diverse,
notes: What SGPO is and how it differs from REACH

text: building shared goals and mutual trust between citizens and the government is paramount. Singaporeans also want to contribute to issues close to their heart. The Government welcomes this and is committed to supporting more ground-up efforts by Singaporeans to shape and improve their communities. The Singapore Government Partnerships Office (SGPO) was officially launched by Deputy Prime Minister and Minister for Finance Lawrence Wong on 19 Jan 2024 to strengthen the government's partnerships and engagements with citizens. The new office is a response to aspirations shared by citizens during the Forward Singapore ↗ exercise to shape their communities, as well as co-create policies, public spaces and services. 2. How does this website help me to partner the government for the public good? The SGPO website is a first-stop platform. If you want to act on ideas that contribute to the public good, this website will help inform and connect you with relevant agencies and resources. Please click on the Partners Portal page for more details.
notes: What SGPO is and how it differs from REACH

text: 3. How does the SGPO website differ from existing platforms like REACH? REACH ↗ is the lead agency in facilitating whole-of-government efforts to engage and connect with you on national and social issues close to your hearts. Its key roles are to gauge ground sentiments, engage citizens for feedback, and promote active citizenry through public consultation. SGPO's mission complements this by supporting those who want to take action on issues they care about, through partnership with the Government. To find out more on SG Partnerships Fund, please visit SGPF FAQs. If you are already clear on how to submit a proposal you want to take action on, share your proposal Submit proposal If not, please head to our Partners Portal page to explore resources that may support your idea.

text: MINISTRY OF CULTURE, COMMUNITY AND YOUTH SG PARTNERSHIPS FUND (SEED) INSTRUCTIONS About this grant The SG Partnerships Fund (SGPF) aims to support citizens who want to step up and lead efforts to contribute to the community. If you are an individual, ground-up or SG-registered organisation keen to partner the Government on a project, we provide funding and support to help you succeed. The SG Partnerships Fund provides tiered support for projects at different levels: If you have a new idea or pilot project that benefits your community, you can apply for the Seed tier below. For projects of larger scale and impact, you may wish to explore the Sprout and Scale tiers (applications for Scale tier open from July 2026). If you intend to make a profit from this project, your project will not be eligible under this grant. Need inspiration?
notes: SGPF Seed tier - up to $5000 100% supportable costs year-round applications

text: Check out more examples of supportable projects and initiatives here: https://www.sgpo.gov.sg/feature-stories/. Who can apply? For individuals/ground-up groups You must be a Singapore Citizen/Permanent Resident residing in Singapore. SingPass will be required to log into OurSG Grants portal to submit an application. For ground-up groups, please nominate one representative to submit the application on behalf of the group. For organisations Your organisation must be officially registered and operate in Singapore. This includes Companies/Corporates, Non-profit Organisations, Societies, Cooperatives and Social Enterprises. CorpPass will be required to log into OurSG Grants portal to submit an application. Contact person/applicant must be a Singapore Citizen/Permanent Resident who is residing in Singapore. When can I apply? The SG Partnerships Fund (Seed) tier is open for applications throughout the year. How much funding can you receive? Successful applicants may receive funding of up to 100% of supportable costs for your project, capped at $5,000 and up to 1 year. Final approved funding amounts will depend on assessment of project merit, supportable costs and actual expenditures. Up to 50% of approved funding will be disbursed upfront upon acceptance of the Letter of Award, while the remainder will be reimbursed upon the submission of project completion updates and your claims form. Please refer to the details in the FAQs. How to apply?
notes: SGPF Seed tier - up to $5000 100% supportable costs year-round applications

text: The application takes about 15 mins to complete with all the information on hand. All fields are mandatory unless otherwise stated. We aim to share the outcome of your application within 4 weeks. As we are currently receiving a high volume of applications, we seek your understanding that more time may be needed to review your application during this period. DOCUMENTS REQUIRED FOR APPLICATION SGPF (Seed) Budget Template (XLSX 21 KB) (please complete this template or upload your existing budget document) Any relevant documents (e.g. video links, presentations, project materials) Total upload size per submission must not exceed 50MB. APPLY AS AN INDIVIDUAL APPLY AS AN ORGANISATION You will be directed to login via Singpass. Upon successful login, select the relevant UEN ID.
notes: SGPF Seed tier - up to $5000 100% supportable costs year-round applications

text: MINISTRY OF CULTURE, COMMUNITY AND YOUTH SG PARTNERSHIPS FUND (SPROUT) INSTRUCTIONS About this grant The SG Partnerships Fund (SGPF) aims to support citizens who want to step up and lead efforts to contribute to the community. If you are an individual, ground-up or SG-registered organisation keen to partner the Government on a project, we provide funding and support to help you succeed. The SG Partnerships Fund provides tiered support for projects at different levels: If you are looking to grow and amplify your project's impact across multiple communities and stakeholder groups, you can apply for the Sprout tier below. If you are looking to test a new, small-scale idea that benefits your community, you may wish to explore the Seed tier instead. For projects of larger scale and sector-wide impact, you may wish to explore the Scale tier instead (applications will open from July 2026). If you intend to make a profit from this project, your project will not be eligible under this grant. Need inspiration?
notes: SGPF Sprout tier - up to $50000 80% supportable costs quarterly application windows

text: Check out more examples of supportable projects and initiatives here: https://www.sgpo.gov.sg/feature-stories/. Who can apply? For individuals/ground-up groups You must be a Singapore Citizen/Permanent Resident residing in Singapore. Singpass will be required to log into OurSG Grants portal to submit an application. For ground-up groups, please nominate one representative to submit the application on behalf of the group. For organisation Your organisation must be officially registered and operate in Singapore. This includes Companies/Corporates, Non-profit Organisations, Societies, Cooperatives and Social Enterprises. Corppass will be required to log into OurSG Grants portal to submit an application. Contact person/applicant must be a Singapore Citizen/Permanent Resident who is residing in Singapore. When can I apply? The SG Partnerships Fund (Sprout) tier is open for applications from January - February, April - May, July - August and October - November. How much funding can you receive? Successful applicants may receive funding for up to 80% of supportable costs for your project, capped at $50,000 and up to 2 years. Final approved funding amounts will depend on assessment of project merit, supportable costs and actual expenditures. Up to 40% of approved funding will be disbursed upfront upon acceptance of the Letter of Award. The rest will be disbursed after you've successfully completed your project and submitted your project completion report and claims form. Please refer to the details in the FAQs.
notes: SGPF Sprout tier - up to $50000 80% supportable costs quarterly application windows

text: How to apply? The application takes about 30 mins to complete with all information on hand. All fields are mandatory unless otherwise stated. We aim to share the outcome of your application within 8 weeks. As we are currently receiving a high volume of applications, we seek your understanding that more time may be needed to review your application during this period. DOCUMENTS REQUIRED FOR APPLICATION You will need to complete and submit the following documents: SGPF (Sprout) Budget Template (XLSX 21 KB) For individuals: CV and bios of applicants, yourself and partners/collaborators For organisations: CV or biographical information of key personnel and Board Executive Committee members Total upload size per submission must not exceed 50MB. APPLY AS AN INDIVIDUAL APPLY AS AN ORGANISATION You will be directed to login via Singpass. Upon successful login, select the relevant UEN ID.
notes: SGPF Sprout tier - up to $50000 80% supportable costs quarterly application windows

text: MINISTRY OF CULTURE, COMMUNITY AND YOUTH SG PARTNERSHIPS FUND (SCALE) INSTRUCTIONS About this grant The SG Partnerships Fund (SGPF) aims to support citizens who want to step up and lead efforts to contribute to the community. If you are an individual, ground-up or SG-registered organisation keen to partner the Government on a project, we provide funding and support to help you succeed. The SG Partnerships Fund provides tiered support for projects at different levels: Scale If you are an SG-registered organisation ready to scale your initiative to drive sector-wide impact, you can apply for the Scale tier below. Your initiative must meet the following objectives: A new or scaled-up initiative which demonstrates measurable sector-wide or systems-wide impact and reach, across multiple communities, stakeholder groups and locales. Addresses demonstrated sectoral needs and creates positive social outcomes. Active involvement of other citizens, community partners and organisations, in co-creation and co- implementation of the initiative. The SGPF does not support projects centred on commercial objectives or business development. Requests for funding to sustain existing programmes or existing organisational functions will also not be supported. Seed and Sprout If you are looking to test a new, small-scale idea that benefits your community, you may wish to explore the Seed tier instead.
notes: SGPF Scale tier - up to $1000000 80% costs Jan-Feb and Jul-Aug windows SG-registered orgs only

text: If you are looking to grow and amplify your project's impact across multiple communities and stakeholder groups, you may wish to explore the Sprout tier instead. Note: All funding decisions are final and the SGPF reserves the right to approve or reject any application at its sole discretion. Need inspiration? Check out more examples of supportable projects and initiatives here: https://www.sgpo.gov.sg/feature-stories/. Example of a Scale initiative: A multi-year place-based community health programme which convenes various healthcare partners, social enterprises and the community in co-creation and co-delivery. The initiative grows collaborative capacity on the ground, cultivating 3,000 community health champions over multiple locales to embark on health movement projects of their own. Who can apply? Your organisation must be officially registered and operate in Singapore. This includes companies/corporates, non-profit organisations, societies, cooperatives and social enterprises. Corppass will be required to log into OurSG Grants portal to submit an application. Contact person/applicant must be a Singapore Citizen/Permanent Resident who is residing in Singapore. When can I apply? The SG Partnerships Fund (Scale) tier is open for applications from January - February and July - August. Applications undergo a rigorous evaluation framework in batches every application window cycle and the selection process is highly competitive. Applicants will be notified of the outcome within 5 to 7 months of submission. How much funding can you receive? Successful applicants may receive funding for up to 80% of supportable programme and organisational capacity costs for your project, capped at $1,000,000. Final approved funding amounts will depend on assessment of project merit, supportable costs and actual expenditures.
notes: SGPF Scale tier - up to $1000000 80% costs Jan-Feb and Jul-Aug windows SG-registered orgs only
